text: 把手放到镜头前吧。
翻一下手，手背对着镜头。
顺着圆圈慢慢找。
就是这里，轻轻稳住。
很好，就这样稳稳按住。
松开手指，放松呼吸。
没关系，慢慢回到穴位上。
保持得很好，完成了。
用另一只手的指尖，在虚线圈附近按一按找找。
有点远了，回到虚线圈附近。
按住不动一小会儿。
很好 — 现在可以保存这个位置了。
把对方的手放进画面吧。
把对方的手翻过来，手背对着镜头。
用你的指尖，在对方手上的虚线圈附近按一按找找。
翻一下手，手心对着镜头。
把对方的手翻过来，手心对着镜头。
已记住你的位置 — 圆圈就在那里。
中渚。在手背，第4、5掌骨小头后方的凹陷处（无名指与小指掌指关节后方的凹沟）。手背朝上。沿无名指与小指指节之间的缝向下滑，指节后方能摸到两根手骨之间的小凹陷。摸到两骨之间那个略酸的小凹陷了吗？
内关。在前臂掌侧，腕横纹上约2寸，两筋之间。掌心朝上。三横指并拢放在腕横纹上方，第三指外侧缘下、两条肌腱之间即是（手掌微握时肌腱会浮起）。指尖下摸到那两条肌腱了吗？
外关。在前臂背侧，腕背横纹上约2寸，与内关相对。前臂背面朝上。腕背横纹上三横指，两骨之间正中 — 与掌面的内关正相对。在腕上三横指、两骨正中了吗？
劳宫。在手掌中央，约当第2、3掌骨之间偏于第3掌骨处。掌心朝上。把中指弯向掌心，指尖触到掌心处即是 — 就在手掌正中。指尖正落在掌心中央了吗？
神门。在腕部，腕掌侧横纹尺侧端，尺侧腕屈肌腱的桡侧凹陷处。掌心朝上。沿腕横纹向小指侧摸，会碰到一颗豌豆大的小圆骨 — 穴位就在它前方的横纹上。摸到掌根那颗小圆骨了吗？
后溪。在手尺侧，第5掌指关节后方，握拳时横纹尽头赤白肉际处。轻轻握拳。在手的小指侧，找到掌横纹的尽头 — 穴位就在指节后方、手心和手背肤色交界的地方。摸到手侧掌纹尽头的位置了吗？
液门。在手背，第4、5指缝间，指蹼缘后方赤白肉际处。手背朝上。找到无名指与小指之间的指蹼，向手腕方向滑一点，落在两指分开处的柔软凹陷里。指蹼后方那个略酸的软凹陷，摸到了吗？
少府。在手掌，第4、5掌骨之间，握拳时小指尖所指处。掌心向上。轻轻握拳，小指指尖点到掌心的位置就是它，在第四、五掌骨之间。小指指尖落到的那个柔软凹陷？
鱼际。在手掌，第1掌骨中点桡侧，赤白肉际处（大鱼际隆起边缘）。掌心向上。沿拇指根部的隆起（鱼际）找到中点，正在手掌与手背肤色交界处。鱼际隆起中段、肤色交界上的酸胀点？
太渊。在腕部，腕掌侧横纹桡侧端，桡动脉搏动处的凹陷中。掌心向上。腕横纹拇指侧能摸到脉搏，穴位就在脉搏旁靠拇指的小凹陷里 — 按在凹陷上，不要压住脉搏。脉搏旁边那个小凹陷？
阳溪。在腕背侧横纹桡侧，拇指上翘时两条肌腱之间的凹陷（鼻烟窝）中。拇指翘起（像竖大拇指）。拇指根部会绷起两条筋，穴位在两筋之间、靠近腕横纹的凹窝里。两筋之间那个三角形凹窝？
腕骨。在手尺侧，第5掌骨底与三角骨之间的凹陷处，赤白肉际。手背朝上，看小指侧。从第五掌骨底向手腕方向滑，快到腕骨时会落进一个凹陷。手掌外缘、腕骨前方的凹陷？
印堂。在头部，两眉头连线的中点处（眉间正中，鼻根上方）。
太阳。在头部颞侧，眉梢与外眼角连线中点向后约1寸的凹陷处（太阳穴）。
百会。在头部正中线上，两耳尖连线与正中线的交点处，前发际正中直上5寸。从两侧耳尖向上摸，两条线在头顶正中相交处就是它，正中线上略有凹陷。头顶正中那个略凹的位置？
四神聪。在头顶部，百会（GV20）前、后、左、右各旁开1寸处，共四穴。
膻中。在胸部，前正中线上，平第4肋间隙，约当两乳头连线的中点。在胸骨上，两乳头连线的中点，正中线上 — 是骨面上的平坦点，不在软组织上。胸骨正中那个略酸的点？
俞府。在胸部，锁骨下缘，前正中线旁开2寸的凹陷处。沿锁骨下缘向胸骨中线滑，停在离中线约两个拇指宽处，锁骨下方的凹陷里。锁骨下缘的那个凹陷？
中脘。在上腹部，前正中线上，脐上4寸，约当胸骨下端与肚脐连线的中点。在上腹正中线上，肚脐与胸骨下端的正中间。肚脐与胸骨下端正中那个柔软的位置？
天枢。在腹部，横平脐中，前正中线旁开2寸。从肚脐中心向两侧各量约两个拇指宽，与肚脐齐平。与肚脐齐平、旁开约两拇指宽的位置？
曲池。屈肘成直角，在肘横纹外侧端凹陷处，即尺泽(LU5)与肱骨外上髁连线的中点。屈肘成直角。肘横纹在拇指侧到头，穴位就在横纹外侧尽头的凹陷处。肘横纹外端那个凹陷？
尺泽。在肘横纹上，肱二头肌腱桡侧缘的凹陷处。掌心向上，微屈肘。摸到肘横纹中央的大筋，穴位在其拇指侧的凹陷里。大筋拇指侧的凹陷？
阳池。在腕后区，腕背侧远端横纹上，指伸肌腱的尺侧缘凹陷中。手腕背面朝上。从无名指根部沿腕背横纹摸，穴位是横纹上的一个软凹陷、在肌腱靠小指侧。摸到腕背横纹上的软凹陷了吗？
大陵。在腕前区，腕掌侧远端横纹中，掌长肌腱与桡侧腕屈肌腱之间。掌心朝上。穴位在腕掌横纹正中，两条肌腱之间的凹陷处（手掌微握时肌腱浮起）。在腕横纹正中的凹陷里了吗？
足三里。在小腿前外侧，犊鼻(ST35)下3寸，胫骨前嵴外开一横指处。屈膝而坐。四指并拢放在膝眼下方，在第四指下缘、距胫骨前嵴外侧约一横指的肌肉上。胫骨旁肌肉上那个略酸的结实点？
阳陵泉。在小腿外侧，腓骨头前下方凹陷处。屈膝而坐。摸到小腿外侧膝下的圆形骨突，穴位在其前下方的凹陷中。骨突前下方的凹陷？
血海。在大腿内侧，髌底内侧端上2寸，股内侧肌隆起处。屈膝而坐。用对侧手掌盖住膝盖、手指朝大腿方向，拇指所指处即是，在大腿内侧肌肉隆起上。膝内上方肌肉隆起处的酸胀点？
梁丘。在股前外侧，髌底外侧端上2寸，股外侧肌凹陷处。屈膝而坐。在髌骨外上角上方约两个拇指宽处，大腿外侧肌肉的凹陷中。髌骨外上角上方的结实凹陷？
犊鼻。在膝前，屈膝时髌韧带外侧凹陷处（外膝眼）。屈膝。髌骨下方、髌韧带两侧会出现两个凹陷（膝眼），穴位是外侧那个。髌骨下方外侧的那个凹陷？
太冲。足背，第1、2跖骨间，跖骨底结合部前方的凹陷中。足背。沿拇趾与第二趾之间的缝向脚踝方向滑，手指停在两骨相接处的凹陷里。此处有时能摸到脉搏，请轻按。两骨相接处的那个凹陷？
内庭。足背，第2、3趾间，趾蹼缘后方赤白肉际处的凹陷中。足背。找到第二、三趾之间的趾蹼，向后滑一点，落进小凹陷。趾蹼后方的小凹陷？
涌泉。足底，屈足卷趾时足心最凹陷处，约当足底第2、3趾缝与足跟连线的前1/3与后2/3交点处。足底。蜷起脚趾，足底前三分之一处出现的最深凹陷就是它。蜷趾时足底最深的那个凹陷？
太溪。踝区，内踝尖与跟腱之间的凹陷中，与内踝尖平齐。内踝。摸到内踝尖，向跟腱方向平移，穴位在内踝尖与跟腱之间的凹陷中，与踝尖齐平。内踝与跟腱之间的凹陷？
Bring your hand into view.
Turn your hand over — back to the camera.
Ease over toward the ring.
That's it — settle in.
Good — keep that steady press.
Release — and breathe.
No rush — ease back onto the point.
Nicely held — all done.
Feel around the dashed ring with your other fingertip.
A little far — closer to the dashed ring.
Hold the press still a moment.
Good — you can save this spot now.
Bring their hand into view.
Turn their hand over — back to the camera.
Feel around the dashed ring on their hand with your fingertip.
Turn your hand over — palm to the camera.
Turn their hand over — palm to the camera.
Saved — the ring now sits on your spot.

Zhongzhu. On the back of the hand, in the groove behind the heads of the 4th and 5th metacarpals (behind the ring- and little-finger knuckles). Back of the hand up. Slide a fingertip down the gap between your ring and little-finger knuckles; just behind them you drop into a small dip between the two hand bones. Feel the small tender dip between the bones?

Neiguan. On the palmar side of the forearm, about two cun above the wrist crease, between the two tendons. Palm up. Lay three fingers across the forearm just above the wrist crease; the spot is under the far edge of your third finger, between the two tendons that rise when you cup your hand. Feel the two tendons under your fingertip?

Waiguan. On the dorsal side of the forearm, about two cun above the dorsal wrist crease, opposite Neiguan. Back of the forearm up. Measure three fingers above the wrist crease, midway between the two forearm bones — directly opposite Neiguan on the palm side. Midway between the two forearm bones, three fingers up?

Laogong. At the center of the palm, between the second and third metacarpal bones, nearer the third. Palm up. Curl your middle finger in until its tip touches your palm — the spot is right where the tip lands, in the centre of the palm. Fingertip resting in the centre of your palm?

Shenmen. At the wrist, on the ulnar end of the palmar crease, in the depression on the radial side of the flexor carpi ulnaris tendon. Palm up. Run a finger along the wrist crease toward the little-finger side until you meet a small pea-shaped bone; the spot sits just before it, on the crease. Feel the little round bone at the base of the palm?

Houxi. On the ulnar side of the hand, in the depression proximal to the head of the fifth metacarpal bone, at the end of the crease when a loose fist is made. Make a loose fist. On the little-finger edge of your hand, find where the main palm crease ends — the spot is just behind the knuckle, where palm skin meets back-of-hand skin. Feel where the crease ends on the side of your hand?

Yemen. On the back of the hand, between the ring and little fingers, just proximal to the margin of the web. Back of the hand up. Find the web between your ring and little fingers, then slide just behind it toward the wrist — you land in a soft dip where the two fingers part. A soft, slightly tender dip just behind the web?

Shaofu. On the palm, between the fourth and fifth metacarpal bones — where the tip of the little finger lands when a fist is made. Palm up. Make a loose fist — where the tip of your little finger touches the palm is the spot, between the fourth and fifth hand bones. The soft hollow your little fingertip lands on?

Yuji. On the palm, at the midpoint of the first metacarpal bone on its radial side, at the border of the thenar eminence. Palm up. Follow the fleshy mound at the base of your thumb to its midpoint, right where the pale palm skin meets the back-of-hand skin. The tender middle of the thumb mound, on the colour border?

Taiyuan. At the wrist, on the radial end of the palmar crease, in the depression beside the radial artery. Palm up. At the thumb side of the wrist crease you can feel a pulse — the point sits in the small hollow right beside it, toward the thumb. Rest on the hollow, not on the pulse. The small hollow beside the pulse?

Yangxi. On the radial side of the dorsal wrist crease, in the hollow between the two tendons that appears when the thumb is raised (the anatomical snuffbox). Lift your thumb as if hitchhiking. Two tendons stand up at its base — the point is in the hollow between them at the wrist crease. The triangular hollow between the two tendons?

Wangu. On the ulnar side of the hand, in the depression between the base of the fifth metacarpal bone and the triquetrum. Back of the hand up, little-finger side. Slide from the base of the little-finger hand bone toward the wrist — you drop into a dip just before the wrist bone. The dip on the edge of the hand, just before the wrist?
Yintang. On the forehead, at the midpoint between the medial ends of the two eyebrows (the glabella), per WHO Standard 2008.
Taiyang. At the temple, in the depression about 1 cun posterior to the midpoint between the lateral end of the eyebrow and the outer corner of the eye.

Baihui. On the vertex, on the head midline, where the line joining the two ear apexes crosses it; 5 cun behind the front hairline (WHO Standard 2008). Run a finger up from the top of each ear until the two lines meet on the crown — the point is where they meet, in a slight dip on the midline. The slight dip at the very top of the head?
Sishencong. On the vertex, a group of four points 1 cun anterior, posterior, left, and right of Baihui (GV20).

Shanzhong. On the anterior midline of the chest, on the sternum, level with the 4th intercostal space — roughly midway between the nipples (WHO Standard). On the breastbone, midway between the nipples, on the centre line — a flat spot on the bone rather than on soft tissue. A slightly tender spot on the breastbone centre line?

Shufu. On the upper chest, in the depression on the lower border of the clavicle, 2 cun lateral to the anterior midline (WHO Standard). Find your collarbone and slide along its lower edge toward the centre; stop about two thumb-widths out from the midline, in the hollow under the bone. The hollow just under the collarbone?

Zhongwan. On the upper abdomen, on the anterior midline, 4 cun above the navel — roughly midway between the navel and the lower end of the sternum (WHO Standard). On the centre line of your upper belly, midway between your navel and the lower tip of the breastbone. The soft midpoint between navel and breastbone?

Tianshu. On the abdomen, 2 cun lateral to the centre of the navel (WHO Standard). Two thumb-widths out to the side from the centre of your navel, level with it. Level with the navel, a couple of thumb-widths out?

Quchi. With the elbow flexed, in the depression at the outer (thumb-side) end of the elbow crease, midway between Chize (LU5) and the lateral epicondyle (WHO Standard 2008). Bend your elbow to a right angle. The crease ends on the thumb side — the point sits in the dip right at that outer end. The dip at the outer end of the elbow crease?

Chize. On the cubital crease, in the depression on the thumb (radial) side of the biceps tendon (WHO Standard 2008). Palm up, elbow slightly bent. Feel the big tendon in the middle of the elbow crease — the point is in the dip just to the thumb side of it. The dip beside the tendon, on the thumb side?

Yangchi. On the back of the wrist, at the dorsal wrist crease, in the depression on the little-finger side of the extensor digitorum tendon (WHO Standard 2008). Back of the wrist up. Follow the wrist crease from the base of your ring finger; the spot is a soft hollow on the crease, just to the little-finger side of the tendon. Feel the soft hollow on the back of the wrist?

Daling. On the palm-side of the wrist, at the wrist crease, midway between the two tendons (palmaris longus and flexor carpi radialis) (WHO Standard 2008). Palm up. The spot is in the middle of the wrist crease, in the dip between the two tendons that rise when you cup your hand. In the centre dip of the wrist crease?

Zusanli. On the anterolateral lower leg, 3 cun below Dubi (ST35), one finger-breadth lateral to the front crest of the shin bone (WHO Standard). Sit with the knee bent. Lay four fingers together below the outer dip of your kneecap — at the lowest finger, move one finger-width out from the shin crest onto the muscle. A firm, slightly sore spot on the muscle beside the shin bone?

Yanglingquan. On the outer lower leg, in the depression in front of and below the head of the fibula. Sit with the knee bent. Feel the small round bone bump on the outer lower leg just below the knee — the point is in the dip just in front of and below it. The dip below the round bone bump?

Xuehai. On the inner thigh, 2 cun above the inner-upper corner of the kneecap, on the bulge of the vastus medialis muscle. Sit with the knee bent. Cup your opposite palm over the kneecap, fingers up the thigh — the point is under your thumb, on the bulge of the inner thigh muscle. The tender bulge of muscle above the inner knee?

Liangqiu. On the front-outer thigh, 2 cun above the outer-upper corner of the kneecap, in the depression on the vastus lateralis. Sit with the knee bent. About two thumb-widths above the outer top corner of the kneecap, in the dip on the outer thigh muscle. A firm dip above the outer corner of the kneecap?

Dubi. On the front of the knee, with the knee bent, in the depression to the outer side of the patellar ligament (the 'lateral eye of the knee'). Bend the knee. Two dimples appear under the kneecap, either side of the tendon — the point is the outer one. The outer dimple under the kneecap?

Taichong. On the top of the foot, in the hollow just beyond where the 1st and 2nd foot bones meet (WHO Standard 2008). Top of the foot. Slide a fingertip back along the groove between your big toe and second toe — the point is where the two foot bones meet and your finger stops. Rest gently; a pulse can sometimes be felt here. The hollow where the two foot bones meet?

Neiting. On the top of the foot, between the 2nd and 3rd toes, in the depression just behind the web margin (WHO Standard 2008). Top of the foot. Find the web between your second and third toes and slide just behind it into the small dip. The small dip just behind the toe web?

Yongquan. On the sole, in the deepest depression when the toes are curled, at the front third of the line from the 2nd–3rd toe web to the back of the heel (WHO Standard 2008). Sole of the foot. Curl your toes — the deepest hollow that appears in the front third of the sole is the spot. The deepest hollow when you curl your toes?

Taixi. On the inner ankle, in the hollow between the tip of the inner ankle bone and the Achilles tendon, level with the ankle-bone tip (WHO Standard 2008). Inner ankle. Feel the tip of the inner ankle bone, then slide straight back toward the Achilles tendon — the point is in the hollow between them, level with the bone tip. The hollow between ankle bone and tendon?
